newsitem.title: USA: Trump Hotels October win rose.
newsitem.headline: Trump Hotels October win rose.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc said Tuesday the Trump Taj Mahal Casino Resort had an October casino win of $44.4 million, compared with $43.8 million for the same month a year ago, a 1.4 percent increase.
The company said the Trump Plaza Hotel & Casino's October win was $31.6 million, compared with $27.8 million in October, 1995, a 13.7 percent increase.
The Taj Mahal also led all other Atlantic City hotel casinos in table win with $19.2 million, compared with $18 million in the same month a year ago, a 6.7 percent increase, the company said.

The Plaza led the other hotel casinos in slot win, with $23.6 million, compared with $19.4 million in October 1995, a 21.3 percent increase. The Taj Mahal was second in slot win with $23.4 million for the month.
"We expect to see continued strong performance through the rest of this year, especially with our bookings at capacity for the holiday season," Trump Hotels said.
